redemption.line: I need a photo-opportunity, I want a shot at redemption
stanza: A man walks down the street, he says, "Why am I soft in the middle now?
Why am I soft in the middle? The rest of my life is so hard
I need a photo-opportunity, I want a shot at redemption
Don't wanna end up a cartoon in a cartoon graveyard"
And all the way down gospel street
A dead bird was hauling an ivory box
You just buried the last chance you got
